oneOf.description: Keep running (the daemon also serves local clients and schedulers).

DaemonGateway.description:
`daemon.toml [gateway]`: the messaging gateway keys every served
profile shares.

http.description: The shared HTTP listener of webhook-style adapters.

limits.description: How much the daemon runs at once across profiles and surfaces.

on_all_adapters_down.description:
What the daemon does once every messaging adapter failed for good:
keep serving local clients and schedulers, or exit 78.

relay.description: The relay connector (`prometheus gateway enroll` writes it).

DaemonSection.description:
The `[daemon]` section (spec: workspace-architecture, One daemon per
Prometheus home; Stale daemon build detection).

autostart.description:
Interactive clients (`prometheus tui`, the ACP adapter) start the
daemon detached when it is not running; `false` makes them exit 69
instead.

idle_session_close_secs.description:
A session with no attached client, no running turn, no open
request and no queued input is closed after this many seconds.

restart_drain_secs.description:
Seconds `prometheus daemon restart` waits for running turns to reach
a turn boundary before it replaces the daemon anyway.

systemd_watchdog_secs.description:
Linux: `> 0` makes the generated systemd unit `Type=notify` with
this `WatchdogSec`; the daemon notifies only while its watchdog
probes succeed. `0` (default): no systemd watchdog.

watchdog.description:
The runtime liveness watchdog (spec: observability, Runtime liveness
watchdog and task dump).

GatewayHttp.description:
`daemon.toml [gateway.http]` (spec: platform-adapters, Shared HTTP
listener for webhook-style platforms).

listen.description:
Where every webhook-style adapter is served, at
`/p/<profile>/<platform>/`.

public.description:
Allow a non-loopback `listen` address (logged at WARN on every
start).

max_concurrent_sessions.description:
Sessions with a running turn at once, across every profile and
surface; further turns wait first in, first out ("Waiting for a
free slot"). `0`: unbounded.

max_live_client_sessions.description:
Detached TUI, desktop and dashboard sessions kept loaded; the least
recently active beyond it are unloaded (never one running a turn or
with a client attached) and resumed from storage when reopened.
`0`: no cap.

LocalBackend.description: `local_runtime.backend`: the llama.cpp build to install and run.

oneOf.description: AMD GPUs through ROCm (only when configured, `x86_64` only).

backend.description: The engine build: `auto` picks one from the probed hardware.

detect_ports.description: Ports probed for a user-run llama-server besides 8080.

enabled.description:
Let Prometheus start and supervise a `llama-server` when a session
needs one. `false` (the default) only detects a running server.

idle_unload_secs.description:
Seconds without a request after which a resident model is unloaded
(it is reloaded by the next request).

port.description: Loopback port of the managed server; `0` picks a free one at start.

PreUpdateBackup.description:
`update.pre_update_backup`: what `prometheus update` saves before the
swap.

oneOf.description: A `pre-update` snapshot of each profile (config, grants, state.db).
The snapshots plus a full home archive under `updates/backups/`.

No backup; the pre-migration snapshot a rollback needs is still
taken when the new build migrates a store.

nofile_soft_limit.description:
Open-file soft limit every process raises itself to at startup on
POSIX hosts, capped by the hard limit and never lowering a higher
limit; children inherit it. `0` disables the raise.

allow_direct_platforms.description: Platforms the relay fronts whose direct adapters still connect.

gateway_id.description: This gateway's id at the connector.

token_secret.description:
The secret holding the gateway credential `prometheus gateway
enroll` obtained (never the value).

url.description:
The connector's WebSocket URL (`wss://`; `ws://` only to a loopback
host). Unset: no relay.

wake_url.description: An `https://` URL the connector calls to wake a scaled-to-zero host.

RpcListenerConfig.description:
`[daemon.rpc]`: the loopback WebSocket every local client attaches to
(spec: workspace-architecture, Ticket-authenticated loopback attachment;
JSON-RPC framing and error codes; Server-to-client requests; Connection
liveness and backpressure).

bind.description:
Listen address. Loopback only (`127.0.0.1`, `::1`); port `0` picks
a free port, recorded as `rpc_url` in `run/gateway.json`. Remote
access goes through the gateway relay, never this listener.

max_frame_bytes.description: Largest accepted frame; a larger one closes the connection with 4413.

request_timeout_secs.description:
Deadline of server-to-client requests other than approvals (which
use the profile's `approvals.timeout_secs`).

workers.description:
Requests run concurrently per connection; `rpc.ping` never waits
for one.

npm.description: Node package registry (used by Node-based plugins, milestone M2).

pypi.description:
Python package index for the Python bridge's packages (used by the
bridge, milestone M2).

RuntimesConfig.description:
The `[runtimes]` section (spec: distribution-and-update, Lazy runtime
installation policy; Persistent runtime opt-outs; Download mirrors).

allow_lazy_install.description:
Install a missing pinned runtime the first time a tool needs it
(asking first on an interactive terminal). `false` makes the tool
fail with a `prometheus runtimes install <name>` hint instead.

exclude.description:
Runtimes nothing may install: not lazily, not `prometheus runtimes
install`, not the pin refresh after an update. `install.sh
--without <name>` records names here.

mirrors.description:
Mirror base URLs used in place of the default origins. Everything
downloaded from a mirror is still checked against the digests pinned
in the binary, so a mirror cannot change what is installed.

SecretName.description:
The name of a secret in the secrets store (`^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]{0,127}$`).
Config keys that need a credential hold a name, never the value.

UpdateConfig.description:
The `[update]` section (spec: distribution-and-update). The release
channel is not here: it belongs to the install receipt.

allow_from_chat.description: Let gateway admins run `/update` from a chat.

auto_apply.description: Install a release found by the background check without asking.

check_interval_secs.description:
Seconds between background checks for a newer release; `0` disables
them. A check sends only the version and target (in the user agent).

mirror_fallback.description:
When a mirror (`update.mirror_url`, `runtimes.mirrors.runtimes`)
still fails after the retry budget, download from the default origin
instead of failing.

mirror_url.description:
Base URL serving release indexes and archives in place of the
default origin (`<url>/channels/<channel>.json`,
`<url>/<tag>/release-manifest.json`, ...). Everything downloaded from
it is still verified against the embedded release keys.

pre_update_backup.description: What to save before the binary is swapped.

require_transparency_log.description:
Also require a keyless transparency-log signature on every release
file, as a second check after the embedded-key signature.

snapshot_keep.description: How many `pre-update` snapshots each profile keeps.

WatchdogConfig.description:
`[daemon.watchdog]`: a thread outside the async runtime probes it; a
runtime that misses `max_strikes` probes in a row is dumped and the
daemon exits 75 so its supervisor restarts it.

max_strikes.description: Consecutive strikes before the dump and exit.

probe_interval_secs.description:
Seconds between probes; a probe not answered within this is a
strike.

daemon.description: The gateway daemon: its client listener and lifecycle.

gateway.description:
Daemon-wide messaging gateway settings (spec: messaging-gateway,
Profiles served by one daemon).

local_runtime.description:
The machine-wide llama.cpp runtime of local models (`prometheus
local`).

process.description: Limits applied to every `prometheus` process of this home.
